evals.prompt: Given an experiment-plan Markdown artifact describing an image-processing pipeline with an input, encoder, feature fusion, and output mask, generate an auditable flowchart spec and CVPR-style figure prompt without inventing metrics or datasets.
evals.expected_output: A validated flowchart-spec JSON, a topology-preserving image prompt, and explicit paper-figure metadata requirements.

evals.prompt: Given an incomplete experiment Markdown that only says a neural network processes images, explain what is missing and return needs_input instead of inventing a pipeline.
evals.expected_output: needs_input with a concise list of missing relationships and scientific details; no image-generation success claim.

evals.prompt: Given a flowchart draft whose English labels are corrupted by image generation, repair the figure without changing topology and use deterministic text overlays when necessary.
evals.expected_output: A targeted repair strategy that preserves nodes and edges and avoids repeated unconstrained image-generation retries.
